tables.name: Inventory
tables.description:
**Role**
Central asset registry at unit level (physical + virtual).

**Core behavior**
- Tracks lifecycle: available → reserved → installed → subscribed
- Mutated by Jobs (not manually controlled)
- Anchors:
  - subscriptions
  - locations
  - tickets
  - monitoring systems

**Key relationships**
- LINK → Resources
- LINK → Locations
- LINK → Subscription contracts
- LINK → Subscriptions
- LINK → Jobs
- LINK → Tickets

**Critical mechanics**
- Installation assigns location + contract
- Serial number uniqueness defines identity
- Status is derived, not authoritative

fields.name: Log
fields.description: Flag to trigger inventory logging

fields.name: Delivery note
fields.description: Used in delivery notes

fields.name: Monitor - Lisa box - DP - Link
fields.description: Link to Device portal based on SN

fields.description: Generates a MAC-like address if Resource contains 'RES-0010', with columns every 2 characters except the last one.

fields.name: Link - To device portal
fields.description: Displays a button to the device portal only if the 'Monitor - Lisa box - DP - Link' is not empty.

fields.name: Brand - Check
fields.description: Checks if Brand matches Subscription contract - Brand or Subscription contract - Brand owner.

fields.name: Uniqlo - Location changed
fields.description: Tick will show when the location has been changed from the original.

fields.name: Alert - Report incident
fields.description: Incident reported on inventory item. Either "Report incident" field is filled out or there's an open ticket attached to the job.

fields.name: Subscription contract - Add new - Record ID
SN - Normalised
fields.description: Extracts the first 14 characters from ID if it is exactly 15 characters long; otherwise returns ID unchanged.

tables.name: Resources
tables.description:
**Role**
Master SKU/product catalog.

**Core behavior**
- Defines all resource types:
  - hardware
  - software
  - consumables
- Drives:
  - BOM logic
  - inventory classification
  - subscription mapping

**Key relationships**
- LINK → Inventory
- LINK → BOM (implicit via Jobs system)
- LINK → Subscription types

**Critical mechanics**
- Classification determines lifecycle behavior
- Acts as normalization layer across system

fields.name: Image

fields.name: Category

fields.name: Brand

fields.name: Type
fields.description: Product type or model family designation (e.g. commercial display, media player).

fields.name: Display - Size "

fields.name: Inventory - Available
fields.description: Count of inventory items with status Available.

fields.name: Inventory - Installed
fields.description: Count of inventory items with status Installed.

fields.name: Inventory - In production
fields.description: Count of inventory items with status In production.

fields.name: Inventory - In transit
fields.description: Count of inventory items with status In transit.

fields.name: Inventory - Pending
fields.description: Count of inventory items with status Pending.

fields.name: Inventory - Spare
fields.description: Count of inventory items flagged as Spare.

fields.name: Inventory - Demo
fields.description: Count of inventory items with status Demo.

fields.name: Inventory - Defect
fields.description: Count of inventory items with status Defect.

fields.name: Stock locations
fields.description: Rollup of stock location names where this resource has current inventory.

fields.name: Inventory
fields.description: Link to Inventory. All physical units of this resource type.

fields.name: Player
fields.description: Flag indicating whether this resource is a media player type.

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: Free-text notes for this resource record.

fields.name: Service

fields.name: SKU
fields.description: Computed SKU string for this resource. Used in quote line items and BOM matching.

fields.name: Quote - Category
fields.description: Product category as used in quote documents (may differ from operational category).

fields.name: Quote - PDF - Specs - Formatted
fields.description: Rollup of formatted spec values from linked Specs records. Used in quote PDF generation.

fields.name: Subscription types
fields.description: Link to Subscription types. The subscription offerings compatible with this resource.

fields.name: Import
fields.description: Link to Import inventory. Import staging records that matched this resource model.

fields.name: Autonumber

fields.name: Frame - Pin type
fields.description: Frame pin type for mounting or installation (e.g. VESA, proprietary). Used in hardware spec sheets.

fields.name: Internal
fields.description: Flags this resource as an internal product not available for client-facing quotes.

fields.name: Quote - Information
fields.description: Additional text information shown in quote line items for this resource.

fields.name: BOM resources
fields.description: BOM resource identifier or cross-reference string. Used in HubSpot integration and BOM matching.

fields.name: Specs
fields.description: Link to Specs. Technical specification records for this resource.

fields.name: Supporting documents
fields.description: Attached manuals, quick-start guides, and supporting documentation for this resource.

fields.name: Trigger
fields.description: Trigger checkbox for automation workflows on this resource record.

fields.name: TargetR - Status
fields.description: TargetR player status string associated with this resource type. Used for monitoring classification.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Computed display name for this resource, typically combining brand, category, and type.

fields.name: Hubspot - Export
fields.description: Checkbox that triggers sync of this resource to FreshSales/HubSpot as a product record.

fields.name: Scan - Data
fields.description: Link to Scan - Line items. Scan sessions that resolved to this resource model.

fields.name: Hubspot - Product type
fields.description: HubSpot product type classification for this resource. Controls how it appears in CRM deals.

fields.name: Is consumable
fields.description: Flags this resource as a consumable (non-serialized, tracked by quantity rather than unit).

fields.name: Consumable Movements
fields.description: Link to Consumable Movements. Stock movement records for this consumable resource.

fields.name: Movement - Amount - Temp
fields.description: Temporary numeric field for staging a quantity value before writing a consumable movement record.

fields.name: Inventory - Consumables - Count
fields.description: Rollup of total consumable quantity on hand across all linked movement records.

tables.name: Stock locations
tables.description:
**Role**
Represents storage/warehouse locations.

**Core behavior**
- Tracks where inventory resides before installation
- Supports logistics and stock distribution

**Key relationships**
- LINK → Inventory

tables.name: Subscription contracts
tables.description:
**Role**
Commercial container for recurring services.

**Core behavior**
- Defines:
  - duration
  - start/end
  - renewal logic

**Key relationships**
- LINK → Subscriptions
- LINK → Inventory
- LINK → Locations

**Critical mechanics**
- Drives auto-renewal
- Attached at installation stage

fields.name: PPU/month
fields.description: Price per unit

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Determines if the subscription is Active or Expired based on the end date.

fields.name: Expiring in (W)
fields.description: Shows weeks until latest end date, only if there is at least one active subscription.

fields.name: BOM resource - Record ID
fields.description: Record ID from BOM Resource triggering contract creation. Synced back to Jobs to associate to correct BOM Resource.

fields.name: Date - test
fields.description: Displays the current date.

fields.name: Check - Brand
fields.description: Validates if the subscription brand matches the available brand, showing a checkmark if true.

fields.name: Status - DS
fields.description:
Status as string, for data source purposes.
The "Status" fields use a formula with single select output, this output is not interpreted correctly by Coupler.io when exporting.

fields.name: DEV - Revenue - Monthly
fields.description: Calculates monthly revenue based on pricing basis and active subscriptions.

fields.name: VA server
fields.description: Defines whether players connected to this contract are running on a EU or Asian VA CMS server.

tables.name: Subscriptions
tables.description:
**Role**
Active recurring revenue records.

**Core behavior**
- Created upon installation
- Tracks lifecycle:
  - active
  - expired
  - terminated

**Key relationships**
- LINK → Inventory
- LINK → Subscription contracts
- LINK → Locations

**Critical mechanics**
- One per license/unit
- Time-dependent state

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Determines the current status of an item based on whether it's terminated or by evaluating the days left until expiration.

fields.name: Trigger - Auto renew
fields.description:
Manual trigger for subscriptions to be pushed to the "Renew" view.
The associated automation will create an auto-renewed record without the "Days left" field having to reach 0

fields.name: Start date - Check
fields.description: True if match

tables.name: Subscription types
tables.description:
**Role**
Defines subscription categories.

**Core behavior**
- Standardizes subscription behavior
- Maps SKU → subscription logic

**Key relationships**
- LINK → Resources
- LINK → Subscriptions

tables.name: Jobs
tables.description:
**Role**
Execution engine.

**Core behavior**
- Drives:
  - installation
  - inventory mutation
  - subscription creation

**Key relationships**
- LINK → Inventory
- LINK → Locations
- LINK → Quotes

**Critical mechanics**
- Core orchestrator of system

tables.name: Countries
tables.description:
**Role**
Geographic reference.

tables.name: Sets
tables.description:
**Role**
Logical grouping of multiple inventory items.

**Core behavior**
- Bundles items into installable kits
- Maintains relationship between components

**Key relationships**
- LINK → Inventory (multiple)

**Critical mechanics**
- Enables multi-device deployments as a single unit
- Does not replace individual inventory tracking

tables.name: Inventory log
tables.description:
**Role**
Event/history tracking for inventory.

**Core behavior**
- Logs changes:
  - status transitions
  - assignments
  - updates

**Key relationships**
- LINK → Inventory
- LINK → Jobs (optional)

**Critical mechanics**
- Provides auditability
- Currently under-modeled vs full event system

tables.name: Customers
tables.description:
**Role**
Customer identity layer.

**Core behavior**
- Defines:
  - brand
  - owner
  - geography

**Key relationships**
- LINK → Locations
- LINK → Quotes
- LINK → Subscriptions

fields.name: Start date - Month
fields.description: Extracts the month from the start date of subscriptions contracts.

fields.name: Revenue - Subscriptions - THB
fields.description: Revenue in THB from active subscriptions

fields.name: Revenue - Subscriptions
fields.description: Revenue from active subscriptions

tables.name: Quotes
tables.description:
**Role**
Commercial input layer.

**Core behavior**
- Defines:
  - scope
  - quantities
  - subscription terms

**Key relationships**
- LINK → Customers
- LINK → Jobs
- LINK → Resources

tables.name: Locations
tables.description:
**Role**
Final consolidation point of operations.

**Core behavior**
- Aggregates:
  - inventory
  - jobs
  - subscriptions
  - tickets
  - documents

**Key relationships**
- LINK → Inventory
- LINK → Subscriptions
- LINK → Jobs
- LINK → Customers

**Critical mechanics**
- Acts as system endpoint for operational data

options.formula:
IF(
  {fldVgtUIhfHBYatPO} < 15, 
  "Online",
  IF(
    AND({fldVgtUIhfHBYatPO} >= 15, {fldVgtUIhfHBYatPO} < 30), 
    "Offline > 15 min", 
    IF(
      AND({fldVgtUIhfHBYatPO} >= 30, {fldVgtUIhfHBYatPO} < 240), 
      "Offline > 30 min",
      IF(
        AND({fldVgtUIhfHBYatPO} >= 240, {fldVgtUIhfHBYatPO} < 480), 
        "Offline > 4 hours",
        IF(
          {fldVgtUIhfHBYatPO} >= 480, 
          "Offline"
        )
      )
    )
  )
)
